title: Energy shield
wikitext:
[[Image:Energy Shield orb.png|thumb|upright|Energy Shield is shown on the player's life orb.]]

{{redirect|Energy Shield|the small passive skill|Energy Shield (passive skill)}}

'''Energy shield''' is a form of [[defence]] that acts as an additional hit point pool on top of [[life]]. Along with [[armour]] and [[evasion]], energy shield is one of the three defence types that can implicitly appear on [[equipment]]. Unlike life, energy shield will recharge naturally after the character has not taken any damage for 2 seconds.

Every [[class]] starts with no energy shield, and gains 1% increased maximum energy shield every 10 [[intelligence]].

__TOC__

==Mechanics==
When a player gains any amount of maximum energy shield from a maximum of 0 ES, energy shield will begin recharging immediately. If maximum energy shield increases or decreases to a non-zero value, the current ES value changes to the same relative percentage of maximum energy shield.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/x7rw3r/comment/inewzqo/</ref>

===Damage mitigation===
If the character has any energy shield remaining when [[damage]] is taken, even damage from [[Labyrinth]] traps, that damage is inflicted on energy shield first. Physical damage reductions and elemental resistances applies to damage [[Damage calculation|before]] it is deducted from energy shield. Damage is only applied to life or mana once all energy shield is depleted. The exception to this is [[chaos damage]], which bypasses energy shield.

====Effects which modify energy shield damage bypass====
; Chaos damage does not bypass Energy Shield
* {{il|Shavronne's Wrappings}}
* {{il|Solaris Lorica}}
* {{il|Esh's Visage}} (while not on Low Life)
* {{il|Coruscating Elixir}} (during flask effect)
* {{il|Corrupted Energy}} (50%)
* {{il|Fleshcrafter}} (for [[minion]]s)
* {{c|mod|30% of Chaos damage does not bypass Energy Shield}} mod on [[Energy Shield Mastery]]
* {{il|The Burden of Truth}} (33%, 40% with Catalysts)
* {{il|Emperor's Vigilance}} (blocked hits only)
* {{il|The Ivory Tower}} (pseudo, taken from Mana before Life)
* {{il|Grasping Mail}} Breach mod - {{ml|BreachBodyChaosDamageDoesNotBypassESNotLowLifeOrMana1_|display=verbose}}

; Non-chaos damage bypass Energy Shield
* [[Divine Flesh]] keystone (All)
** {{il|Mahuxotl's Machination}}
* [[Corrupted Soul]] keystone (50%)
** {{il|Replica Soul Tether}}
* {{il|Corrupted Energy}} (50%, physical)
* {{il|The Burden of Truth}} (33%, 40% with Catalysts)
* {{il|The Fourth Vow}} (physical)

===Recharge===
Recharge is active until it is interrupted by damage to energy shield, or damage to the status energy shield protects—normally life, or mana with {{psl|Eldritch Battery}}<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3729358#p25988470</ref>. It is not interrupted by reaching full energy shield or by [[loss]] from non-damage sources or skill [[cost]]s.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/a1n53x/heres_a_new_unique_item_and_two_early_patch_notes/earf9ak/?context=1</ref>  

====Start of Energy shield Recharge====
[[File:Start time of Energy Shield Recharge.png|thumb|upright=2.0|Effect of {{c|mod|#% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge}}]]
Energy shield will start recharging if the character does not take any damage for a certain period of time. By default, this time is 2 seconds. It can be reduced with {{c|mod|#% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge}} [[modifier]]s from [[passive skill]]s and [[equipment]]. 

Let ''r'' be the sum of {{c|mod| #% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge}} modifiers (as a percentage). The delay period in seconds is given by:

{{math|formula=
\text{Delay Period} = {200 \over 100 + r}
}}

For example, having 100% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge results in a delay period of 1 second.

====Energy shield Recharge Rate====
Energy shield recharge rate modifies [[recovery]] from recharge and is by default:
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character"
 AND id="energy_shield_recharge_rate_per_minute_%" 
|format = ul
}}

This recharge rate can be increased with {{c|mod|#% increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate}} modifiers.

With {{psl|id=eternal_youth_keytone2692}}, recharge rate is 33.33% of life instead.

===Stun prevention===
While the character has any energy shield remaining, the character has a 50% chance to ignore being [[stun]]ned. This bonus is not additive with other stun avoidance modifiers from passive skills and equipment; the chance to ignore stun granted by energy shield is rolled separately.<ref name="stun avoidance" /> This avoidance does not require damage to ''reach'' energy shield; it will work even when all damage is taken by an [[Aegis]] or [[Ward]] first, or bypasses energy shield due to {{psl|Divine Flesh}}. It ''is'' disabled by {{psl|Eldritch Battery}}<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1247469</ref> even when damage can still be taken by energy shield through {{psl|Mind over Matter}}.

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant energy shield bonuses.

===Base energy shield===
These passive skills grant additional base maximum energy shield.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "base_maximum_energy_shield"
}}

===Maximum energy shield===
These passive skills grant unconditional increases or reductions to maximum energy shield.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "maximum_energy_shield_+%"
}}

===Energy shield recharge rate===
These passive skills grant increased rate of energy shield recharge.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "energy_shield_recharge_rate_+%"
}}

===Energy shield delay===
This passive skill grants faster start of energy shield recharge.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "energy_shield_delay_-%"
}}

===Miscellany===
These passive skills are related to energy shield, but do not fit into any other category.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
    passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%energy_shield%"
    AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("base_maximum_energy_shield", "maximum_energy_shield_+%", "energy_shield_recharge_rate_+%", "energy_shield_delay_-%")
}}

===Keystones===
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=
    passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Energy Shield%"
}}

|where=

passive_skills.id LIKE "%vaal_keystone%"

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Energy Shield now recharges at a base amount of 33% per second (previously 20%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.5.0|
* Energy Shield Recharge is no longer interrupted by non-damage changes to your Life or Energy Shield, such as when you spend your Energy Shield on skills via [[Eldritch Battery]].
}}
{{Version history table row|3.0.0|
* Energy Shield as a defensive mechanic has undergone a review and, generally speaking, all sources of Energy Shield on items have been reduced by approximately 20%.
* Elreon's crafted Increased Maximum Energy Shield mod can now only be crafted onto Amulets. The cost has been changed to 8 Chaos orbs (from 1 Exalted orb).
* All local Energy Shield modifiers on items, as well as the base Energy Shield of items, have been reduced at higher levels. Very low-level items will see a slight increase or no change, scaling up to a 33% reduction at the highest tier of modifiers.
* Because of Armour/Energy Shield and Evasion/Energy Shield equipment, we've had to apply this change to the local percentage modifiers on all other armour types as well. To compensate, all inherent values of base Armour and Evasion Rating on equipment are now greater at higher item levels.
* The defences granted by all body armour has been increased at higher levels by 20%.
* These changes will not apply to existing modifiers but will apply to existing base types. As a consequence, the Energy Shield values on many unique items have also been updated.
* The following mods can now be crafted at Haku's Armourer's Bench: +27-34 to Maximum Energy Shield can be applied to all Armour Slots, +35-45 to Maximum Energy Shield can be applied to Body Armour, Shield and Helmet, +56-69 to Maximum Energy Shield can be applied to Body Armour and Shield.
* Local Added Energy Shield modifiers have been rebalanced at all levels. Early mods grant more energy shield, dropping to 36%-45% less energy shield at the highest tier.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.0|
* The {{ml|LocalIncreasedEnergyShield11}} mod can no longer spawn on shields.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.3|
* Energy shield now makes it a lot harder to get stunned, but doesn't prevent it all the time like it did before.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.4|
* Improved Energy Shield on items by 34%.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.3|
* Players can now not get stunned if they currently have any remaining energy shield. Greatly reduced amount of energy shield on [[item]]s to compensate for this new behaviour.
* Nerfed quantity of energy shield delay mod available.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.6.8|
* Nerfed energy shield quantities by 50%.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
